scope: behavioral schedules, not implementation or test-run results

cases.name: temporary_selection_exposure
schedule: Start with prefix + ghbdtn + suffix.
Select only ghbdtn through the rejected AX mechanism.
Deliver ordinary x before replacement revalidation.
assertions: Show that x overwrites the exposed selection under the rejected mechanism.
Keyrill never creates this temporary selection, so its correction path can't expose the word to this schedule.

cases.name: whole_value_lost_update
schedule: Copy an immutable whole-field snapshot.
Append concurrent input.
Write the old snapshot with the converted word.
assertions: Show that the concurrent input is lost under the rejected mechanism.
Keyrill never replaces a whole value from a snapshot.

cases.name: counted_deletion_interleave
schedule: Commit ghbdtn Space.
Deliver x before seven synthetic Backspaces.
Insert the converted word.
assertions: The rejected stream deletes the wrong suffix and can leave a word prefix.
The composition path never uses synthetic deletion or retyping, and event tagging is not the oracle.
The compatibility backend does counted deletion; its limits are in docs/adr/006-compatibility-backend.md.

cases.name: stale_dispatched_range
schedule: Validate an explicit committed range.
After dispatch, prepend text or change context before that range is applied.
Invalidate the old generation.
assertions: The old request can still mutate the wrong range; invalidation doesn't imply rollback.
Keyrill has no generic committed-range transport; an unknown post-write outcome invalidates receipts and blocks further speculative effects.

cases.name: owned_query_invalidation
schedule: Own a mark with synthetic prefix/suffix.
Inside each native ownership/read callback change generation, caret or client.
Resume the outer operation.
assertions: Zero stale follow-on native writes after observable invalidation.
Unchanged prefix/suffix and no receipt resurrection.
If rejected before any write attempt, ordinary input remains unhandled.

cases.name: foreign_mark_reused_proxy
schedule: Own a word and Space in field A.
Click field B physically.
The client proxy identity is unchanged, but markedRange reports a range from field A.
Attempt one manual command or the next ordinary letter.
assertions: Don't clear or adopt the foreign range or carry A's word into B.
No correction write under uncertain ownership.
Record both whole fields and carets; distinguish a safe refusal from a manual success.

cases.name: native_caret_dom_disagreement
schedule: Own a mark in field A with the caret at its end, then move the mouse from A to B.
Commit readback reports a different caret from the one an independent DOM oracle shows in A.
assertions: Keep both observations, the generation and callback order, and the executable identity.
Don't invent a root cause or guess a caret restoration.
A mismatch alone doesn't show that the document was damaged or that it is safe.

cases.name: empty_composition_deletion
schedule: Use synthetic prefix/suffix and own x.
Backspace the final composing character.
Continue with hello Space.
assertions: Only x disappears; prefix, suffix and the expected caret are preserved.
Empty insertText leaves a stray character in TextEdit and stays as a failing control; the owned empty setMarkedText is the operation under test.
No fallback Backspace or zero-length substring proof.

cases.name: manual_boundary_and_receipt
schedule: Compose ghbdtn.
Manual convert once before Space.
Space.
Reverse once while owned.
Finish and continue hello Space.
assertions: Visible states are привет, привет Space, ghbdtn Space, then ghbdtn Space hello Space.
Explicit intent prevents automatic reconversion at the same boundary.
Expired reversal makes zero native writes; native Undo is separate.

cases.name: boundary_rapid_continuation
schedule: Physically type ghbdtn Space hello Space ghbdtn Space hello Space rapidly.
Repeat in fresh fields without restarting the input method.
assertions: Exact text is привет Space hello Space привет Space hello Space.
No lost, duplicated or reordered events; the suffix and the exact caret are preserved.
Record whether the input was physical or generated.

cases.name: stable_focus_process_reuse
schedule: Keep the same native process.
Alternate generated input in TextEdit documents with physical mouse transitions in a browser.
Switch the source away and back, then type the same two-word correction sequence in a fresh field.
assertions: If a correction is missed, preserve the field before retrying.
Separate delivery, eligibility, composition lifetime, Rust abstention and native-effect mismatch.
Don't assume a common cause with foreign marks or source-selection misses.

cases.name: source_acceptance_vs_delivery
schedule: Request a declared mode.
Read the actual source ID and the running executable identity.
Physically type into a synthetic field and record Rust/native counters plus the document.
assertions: A TIS return of 0 without the selected ID and key delivery is setup only.
Generated noncorrection without Rust calls is not inference abstention.
Preference writes and service resets are not recovery fallbacks.

cases.name: dictionary_snapshot_reload
schedule: Load valid synthetic EN/RU overlays.
Keep a previous immutable snapshot.
Publish a valid update, a candidate with NUL or a non-UTF-8 `/encoding=`, a missing path, an atomic-save rename and a restored valid file.
assertions: A valid snapshot replaces atomically; old readers keep the old valid view.
An invalid or missing update keeps the last good snapshot; a configured file missing from the start disables automatic changes only.
No dictionary write, fake frequency, input logging or per-word editor subprocess.

cases.name: reentrant_key_disposition
schedule: Reenter ordinary input and a reserved correction command while a native effect is busy.
Inject an exception before and after a mutation attempt.
assertions: No ordinary key swallowed merely because the engine is busy.
No blind replay after an attempted/unknown write.
An explicitly unavailable reserved command is distinguishable from ordinary input.
No Rust exclusive borrow crosses the native callback.

cases.name: tsf_grant_and_context
schedule: Reject a synchronous edit session; accept the request but reject the session; reject composition with success and a null composition.
Defer an edit, change context/composition and grant it later.
Terminate an old composition after a new one exists.
assertions: Check the outer HRESULT, the session HRESULT, the write cookie and a non-null composition.
No stale context write and no termination of the current composition.
Key consumption reflects actual handling; observe whole documents under physical input.

cases.name: secure_unsupported_and_shutdown
schedule: Enter a secure, read-only, unknown or excluded control.
Change focus or source, or stop the service, with an owned synthetic word.
assertions: No prohibited text inspection or speculative committed edit.
Finish only a valid owned old mark; drain callbacks before freeing the engine.
No mutation of the new field, no private input persisted and no unexpected test cleanup.
